segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are mostly positive, describing the cream as comfortably hydrating and non-greasy even on very dry or dry-and-sensitive skin, though one reviewer with dry skin found it did not provide enough hydration and thought it better suited to normal skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with reactive or previously peptide-reactive skin, report no irritation or redness from this formula; one reviewer without known sensitivities developed a red rash after two days of use.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cream hydrates without adding a heavy oil feel, and one credits it with visibly lightening dark spots and shrinking the look of her pores.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature, aging, or post-menopausal skin report a comfortable, cushioned hydration and smoother, calmer-looking skin, while cautioning that it functions as a supportive moisturizer rather than a replacement for stronger anti-aging treatments.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother, firmer, more elastic-looking skin with regular use, including two describing notable improvement in skin elasticity after major life changes (early menopause, post-weight-loss skin); one long-term reviewer of three months, however, saw no real difference in texture or elasticity despite daily use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry or very dry skin, report strong, lasting hydration without greasiness; one reviewer with dry skin is the exception, finding it did not hydrate enough and better suited to normal skin.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation, including one who says this is the first peptide cream that hasn't caused red lumps on her skin; one reviewer with no known sensitivities developed a red rash after two days of use.
concerns.barrier: An esthetician reviewer reports the cream helps maintain and repair the skin barrier for clients dealing with compromised barrier, rosacea, and scarring, and one reviewer with very sensitive, reactive skin reports zero reaction; one reviewer, however, developed a red rash she attributes to the product.
concerns.spots: A reviewer with oily skin reports the cream lightened dark spots on her cheek and eyelid, and another reports improved, more even skin tone; feedback specific to spots is limited to a couple of mentions.
concerns.blemishes: An esthetician reviewer reports clients with cystic acne see faster fading of healing acne inflammation, and one reviewer reports her acne flare-ups cleared up within two weeks of consistent use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the cream hydrates without leaving a heavy or greasy oil feel on the skin.

extraits.titre: A Real Support Cream for Mature Skin — Hydrating, Smoothing, and Well Worth UsingA Real Support Cream for Mature Skin —
extraits.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with dry mature skin, I pay close attention to creams that claim peptide support. A lot of them sound impressive on the label but end up feeling like basic moisturizer with trendy words added. This one feels more purposeful. I’ve used several Tosowoong creams at this point, and this is exactly the kind of formula that reminds me why I keep coming back to the brand. The texture is very nice. It feels creamy and nourishing without being too heavy, and it spreads easily over the skin. On my dry skin, it gives that comfortable, cushioned feeling I want from a moisturizer, but it does not sit on top in a greasy layer. It absorbs well and leaves my skin looking smoother, calmer, and more hydrated. Ingredient-wise, copper peptide is the obvious star here. GHK-Cu is one of those ingredients that gets a lot of attention because it is associated with skin repair, firmness support, and overall healthier-looking skin. I do think expectations matter, though. This is not going to act like a prescription retinoid, replace procedures, or suddenly reverse deep wrinkles. That is not realistic for a cream. Where this performs really well is as a supportive moisturizer for skin that needs consistent maintenance. Mature skin often needs barrier support, hydration, and ingredients that help skin look stronger and less tired over time. That is where this fits beautifully into a routine. extraits.titre: Thick copper peptide cream, great for night time use
extraits.texte: Oo this is nice. The blue color comes from the copper, I dont see any dyes in the ingredients. The little blue spheres are like little orbeez gel balls. The burst at the slightest touch. There is no fragrance ingredients, but the cream smells very softly of petroleum. The smell disappears quickly.
